summary: Agent explained home loan foreclosure process and charges to customer.

intents.keywords: Mera home loan ka photo process kya hai?...process samjhata hun kya aap apna loan

issues.issue: Customer wants to know the foreclosure process.

intents.actions of agent: The agent explained that the customer needs to pay outstanding amount and charges for foreclosure and offered to email the exact amount and process.
intents.Process Request: Emailing the exact amount and process for foreclosure.
intents.resolution: Agent will email the exact amount and process for foreclosure.

intents.keywords: Kitna charge lagega?...terms per depend karta hai lekin details email

issues.issue: Customer wants to know the foreclosure charges.

intents.actions of agent: The agent explained that the charges depend on loan terms and the details will be in the email.
intents.resolution: Agent informed customer that details of charges will be in email.
